comments.mergedPostDetails: Can we get some catagories for sorting worlds? Sometimes I want to look up game maps in vrchat or puzzle maps and end up having to sort through hundreds of worlds whose only indicator that they might be a puzzle map is their name. I’m not asking for world descriptions(although that would be nice too), I’m just asking to have World creators be able to give their worlds tags so then I can search for worlds by catagory rather than name. If I’m in the mood for horror then I could search worlds listed as horror or if I wanted a dance world then I could search under dance.
comments.value: I think this will be extremely essential in the future, because if there are many worlds and a person wants a certain spectrum of worlds, they are going to need a search/ tag system for this.

Yeah i noticed that too, when searched for word "Box" to find Lag-Free Box World, now world wont even appear in the search and some random world with red pictures pop up.... Totally agree, world name searching is far better, don't know what happened now

I just typed in "box" in world search and got results that matched. It is using the world description too which can be a little odd. Later on we'll add #tags to worlds so people can attach and also search with hashtags to help.

Please make so you can toggle/select what you wanna search for then. So you can say that you only wanna search for world names or tags or descriptions.

Normally you just see the world name when you look for a world to join. So that would naturally be what you would search. =3
@{58c6d558ff44e44ada717902|full_name}: Neat. Some people might find tags useful.
It's been based on both world name and the upload description for a while I believe; I think people've just been catching on and writing random crap so people see their map pop up

@{58c6d558ff44e44ada717902|full_name}: Yeah, tags would be very useful for certain fandoms. Like, say you want to make a Touhou world called "Gensokyo" without the word "Touhou" in the name, or even (for the sake of argument) description. You'd find "Hakurei Shrine", "Scarlet Devil Manor", etc. searching for "Touhou" as well.
@{5ae69b48ef5d271ee3728677|full_name}: Yeah, this is why tags would be useful. So people won't spam them in the description.
